# U107 artwork

- `official-back.png`: exact-product latest supplied production contours, directly rasterized at 2,400 × 2,400 pixels. Full 30 × 30 mm label retained; current `UP TO 1M` text, black UHF-RFID heading and M5Stack mark take precedence over older public photos showing 2M/blue heading. No photographic pixels or preview enlargement. The converter's incorrect glyph even-odd rule was restored to nonzero so original outlined letter counters render correctly.
- `reference-redraw-front.png`: newly drawn white antenna waves and tag mark from the exact U107 official front photo, transparent 3,300 × 2,200 pixels, mapped over 33 × 22 mm. Colour, stroke weight and registration are photo estimates.

Only final PNGs are distributed. The private table, source vectors, original links, auxiliary preview, mappings, generators and intermediate vector/raster files remain outside the repository. Product marks and printed designs retain their respective rights. The physical enclosure is complete independently of artwork. `artwork:false` is supported and checked. No exhaustive browser pixel review was run.
